verdict.rationale: Firecrawl offers async/webhook delivery for crawl/extract jobs (firecrawl-docs-7, firecrawl-docs-11) and a 'reasoning effort' style agent-search knob (firecrawl-gh-2), which imply some tradeoff between waiting for completeness vs. getting quicker results, but there's no explicit documented parameter (e.g., a 'wait_for'/streaming-vs-batch mode toggle) framed as controlling latency-vs-completeness tradeoffs for scrape/crawl operations. missing for 10: explicit docs describing a latency/completeness control (e.g., partial vs full page load wait, streaming partial results), independent/hands-on confirmation that developers can tune this tradeoff, and clarity on how webhook async delivery vs synchronous calls actually let you choose completeness at request time.
